mods.name: Project Time Master: Reforged
mods.description:
Master time and matter once again!

Project Time Master: Reforged is a dedicated addon for ProjectE and a modern fork of the original 'Project Time Master' mod, buit built specifically for Minecraft 1.21 and newer versions. It brings back the powerful Time Watches with overhauled mechanics, massive power tiers, and total control over your world's tick speed.

Features:
- Tile Entity Acceleration (Machines, Modded Crops, etc.)
- Day/Night Cycle Control (Fast-forward time)
- 8 Power Tiers with configurable ranges and speed multipliers.
- Full EMC Integration and progression.

releases.notes:
[1.5.0] - 2025-12-22
The "Time Control" Update

This version introduces powerful new ways to manipulate the flow of time and improves stability with ProjectE integration.

✨ New Features
Pause & Rewind: Added brand new functionalities to Pause and Rewind time. These features were not present in previous versions and offer complete control over the day/night cycle.

Localization Support: Added lang files structure. The mod is now ready for translation and displays correct names/tooltips in-game.

🐛 Bug Fixes
Pedestal Interaction: Fixed a critical bug where the Clock of Time was not functioning when placed on a Dark Matter Pedestal. It now correctly triggers its area of effect.

🛠️ Technical
Code cleanup for the new time manipulation logic.

releases.notes:
# Changelog

All notable changes to the "Project Time Master: Reforged 1.0.0" project will be documented in this file.

## [1.0.0] - 2025-12-21

### 🎉 Initial Release
First stable release of **Project Time Master: Reforged** for Minecraft 1.21.1. This version is a complete rewrite and modernization of the original Project Time mechanics.

### 🚀 Added
- **Time Watches (MK1 - MK8):** - Implemented 8 tiers of watches.
  - **Right-Click:** Accelerates specific Tile Entities (machines, furnaces, crops).
  - **Shift + Right-Click:** Toggles "Charge Mode" to fast-forward the Day/Night cycle.
- **Dark Matter Pedestal Integration:**
  - Full support for ProjectE Pedestals.
  - Activates an **Area of Effect (AoE)** acceleration field when placed.
  - Radius and Tick Speed scale with the Watch Tier (e.g., MK8 covers a massive area).
- **EMC Integration:**
  - All items have balanced EMC values based on Klein Stars and Dark/Red Matter.
- **Configuration System:**
  - Added `projecttimemasterreforged-common.toml`.
  - Allows players/modpackers to configure max bonus ticks, pedestal ranges, and EMC costs.
- **Audio Feedback:**
  - Added magical chime sounds for activation.
  - Added mechanical click sounds for deactivation.
- **Visuals:**
  - Added dynamic tooltips showing "Bonus Ticks", "Radius", and "Status" (Active/Inactive).
  - New logo and refined item textures matching ProjectE aesthetics.

### 🔧 Fixed & Changed
- **Port to 1.21.1:** Codebase fully rewritten for NeoForge 1.21.
- **Performance:** Optimized the `scanAndAccelerate` logic to reduce TPS lag when using high-tier watches.
- **Recipe Fix:** Resolved NBT tag issues that caused crafting failures in previous development builds. The recipes now correctly accept standard ProjectE items.
- **License:** Project released under the **MIT License**.

### 📦 Dependencies
- Minecraft 1.21.1
- NeoForge 21.1+
- ProjectE (Required)
